case_title: CAROL MONTGOMERY VS. JAMES BESS ET AL

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $10,000.00 FILED BY MONTGOMERY, CAROL AS TO DEFENDANT BESS, JAMES STOKES, DAVID ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR AUG-23-2016 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERVICE $ 45.00 - SERVED JUL-26-2016, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT BESS, JAMES
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF - FEE FOR SERVICE $ 55.00 - SERVED JUL-27-2016, PERSONAL SERVICE AS TO DEFENDANT STOKES, DAVID

SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF AUG-23-2016 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF AUG-23-2016 BY DONALD S. MITCHELL. APPEARANCES BY PLAINTIFF CAROL MONTGOMERY AND JAMES BESS. NO APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT DAVID STOKES. PROOF OF SERVICE ON FILE AS TO BOTH DEFENDANTS. EXHIBITS NOT RETAINED. JUDGE: DONALD S. MITCHELL. CLERK: K. DOUGHERTY. NOT REPORTED. (D506).
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF AUG-23-2016 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MONTGOMERY, CAROL IS NOT OWED ANY MONEY BY DEFENDANT BESS, JAMES STOKES, DAVID A REDUCTION IN RENT, LIKE A LEGAL INCREASE, RE-SETS THE BASE RENT. A LANDLORD CANNOT REDUCE THE BASE RENT AND, THEREAFTER, DEMAND THE DIFFERANCE BETWEEN THE REDUCED RENT AND SOME HIGHER AMOUNT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
